cards.en: What time is the delivery going to arrive?
cards.ja: 配達は何時に届きますか。
cards.glossEn: What time is the delivery going to arrive?

cards.en: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
cards.ja: 豆乳のほうがアーモンドミルクよりとろみがありますか。
cards.glossEn: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?

cards.en: Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.
cards.ja: ハンナはヴィーガンなので、豆乳のほうを飲みます。
cards.glossEn: Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.

cards.en: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
cards.ja: バターを使ったメディアルナには乳製品が入っていますよね。
cards.glossEn: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?

cards.en: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
cards.ja: 豆乳のものと乳糖を含まない牛乳のものを、一杯ずつ持ってきていただけますか。
cards.glossEn: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?

cards.en: What do you think, Hannah? The coconut one is less thick.
cards.ja: ハンナ、どう思う？ココナッツミルクのほうはとろみが少ないよ。
cards.glossEn: What do you think, Hannah? The coconut one is less thick.

cards.en: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
cards.ja: デヴ、今のところ乳糖を含まない牛乳で大丈夫？
cards.glossEn: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?

cards.en: For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.
cards.ja: とりあえずこれを注文して、午後にまた来ます。
cards.glossEn: For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.

reader.en: One Saturday at 10, Nora walks into a café-bakery in San Telmo with her friends Hannah and Dev to have breakfast.
reader.ja: 土曜日の朝10時、ノラは友人のハンナとデヴと一緒に、朝食をとるためサン・テルモのカフェ兼菓子店に入ります。
reader.glossEn: One Saturday at 10, Nora walks into a café-bakery in San Telmo with her friends Hannah and Dev to have breakfast.

reader.en: The server, Matías, tells them that there is no oat milk today because the delivery hasn't arrived yet.
reader.ja: 給仕のマティアスは、配達がまだ届いていないため、今日はオーツミルクがないと伝えます。
reader.glossEn: The server, Matías, tells them that there is no oat milk today because the delivery hasn't arrived yet.

reader.en: Nora: What time is the delivery going to arrive?
reader.ja: ノラ：配達は何時に届きますか。
reader.glossEn: Nora: What time is the delivery going to arrive?

reader.en: Matías: It will arrive in the afternoon, and meanwhile I can offer you another plant-based drink.
reader.ja: マティアス：午後に届きます。その間は、別の植物性の飲み物をご用意できます。
reader.glossEn: Matías: It will arrive in the afternoon, and meanwhile I can offer you another plant-based drink.

reader.en: Matías: We have soy milk and almond milk, which are the ones vegan customers ask for most.
reader.ja: マティアス：豆乳とアーモンドミルクがあります。ヴィーガンのお客さまから最もよく注文されるものです。
reader.glossEn: Matías: We have soy milk and almond milk, which are the ones vegan customers ask for most.

reader.en: Nora: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
reader.ja: ノラ：豆乳のほうがアーモンドミルクよりとろみがありますか。
reader.glossEn: Nora: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?

reader.en: Matías: Yes, the soy one is thicker, and the coconut milk has a sweeter taste than both.
reader.ja: マティアス：はい、豆乳のほうがとろみがあります。ココナッツミルクはその二つより甘い味がします。
reader.glossEn: Matías: Yes, the soy one is thicker, and the coconut milk has a sweeter taste than both.

reader.en: Hannah: I prefer the soy one, because it makes more foam than the coconut one.
reader.ja: ハンナ：豆乳のほうが好き。ココナッツミルクより泡がよく立つから。
reader.glossEn: Hannah: I prefer the soy one, because it makes more foam than the coconut one.

reader.en: Nora: Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.
reader.ja: ノラ：ハンナはヴィーガンなので、豆乳のほうを飲みます。
reader.glossEn: Nora: Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.

reader.en: Dev avoids lactose, so Matías recommends the lactose-free milk to him.
reader.ja: デヴは乳糖を避けているので、マティアスは乳糖を含まない牛乳を勧めます。
reader.glossEn: Dev avoids lactose, so Matías recommends the lactose-free milk to him.

reader.en: Nora: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
reader.ja: ノラ：デヴ、今のところ乳糖を含まない牛乳で大丈夫？
reader.glossEn: Nora: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?

reader.en: Dev: Yes, I'm going to order a lágrima, because it has less coffee than a cortado.
reader.ja: デヴ：うん。コルタードよりコーヒーが少ないラグリマを注文するよ。
reader.glossEn: Dev: Yes, I'm going to order a lágrima, because it has less coffee than a cortado.

reader.en: Nora: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
reader.ja: ノラ：バターを使ったメディアルナには乳製品が入っていますよね。
reader.glossEn: Nora: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?

reader.en: Matías: Yes, but according to the baker, the beef-fat croissant has no butter or milk, although it does contain beef fat.
reader.ja: マティアス：はい。ただ、パン職人によると、牛脂を使ったメディアルナにはバターも牛乳も入っていません。でも牛脂は使っています。
reader.glossEn: Matías: Yes, but according to the baker, the beef-fat croissant has no butter or milk, although it does contain beef fat.

reader.en: Nora: Then Dev is going to eat two beef-fat croissants, and Hannah is going to order a fruit salad.
reader.ja: ノラ：では、デヴは牛脂を使ったメディアルナを二つ食べて、ハンナはフルーツサラダを注文します。
reader.glossEn: Nora: Then Dev is going to eat two beef-fat croissants, and Hannah is going to order a fruit salad.

reader.en: Nora: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
reader.ja: ノラ：豆乳のものと乳糖を含まない牛乳のものを、一杯ずつ持ってきていただけますか。
reader.glossEn: Nora: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?

reader.en: Matías: Of course, and when the delivery arrives, I'm going to save some oat milk for you.
reader.ja: マティアス：もちろんです。配達が届いたら、オーツミルクを取っておきますね。
reader.glossEn: Matías: Of course, and when the delivery arrives, I'm going to save some oat milk for you.

reader.en: Nora: For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.
reader.ja: ノラ：とりあえずこれを注文して、午後にまた来ます。
reader.glossEn: Nora: For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.

speakingGoalJapaneseDraft: あなたは友人の注文をまとめるノラです。AIはサン・テルモのカフェ兼菓子店（コンフィテリア）の給仕マティアスです。豆乳、アーモンドミルク、ココナッツミルクを比べ、ヴィーガンのハンナには豆乳、乳糖を避けているデヴには乳糖を含まない牛乳を選び、配達が午後に届くまでの注文と戻る予定を伝えてください。
issues: Current Spanish source is Nora, Hannah, Dev and Matías at a San Telmo café-bakery at 10 on Saturday. Archived draft uses Hana and an invented kitchen-verification scene; archived lines are not reused.
Card order follows the 23 source words exactly, and the Reader follows all 18 source English/Spanish turns; no learner-facing original Spanish grammar drill is imported.
Soy milk and almond milk are described by Matías as the options vegan customers request most. This is a source-reported order pattern, not an independent ingredient or handling guarantee.
Hannah is vegan and chooses soy milk, then fruit salad. Dev avoids lactose, chooses lactose-free dairy milk and two beef-fat croissants. These dietary needs are distinct.
The beef-fat croissant is reported by the baker to contain no butter or milk but to contain beef fat. The Japanese draft states all three facts and never presents it as vegan.
The source does not have an ingredient/preparation verification pause or provisional ordering hold. Those archived additions are not carried into this candidate.
Lágrima is a local milk-forward coffee drink with less coffee than a cortado; the Japanese draft retains the name and comparison.
Medialuna, medialuna de grasa, confitería and lágrima use draft loanword or descriptive choices; qualified Argentine-food and Japanese terminology review is required.
Coconut milk sweetness and soy foam/thickness are statements in this authored scene, not general food or nutrition claims.
Spanish más/menos … que and future/ir a grammar do not map word-for-word into Japanese. The draft uses natural ～より/～のほうが and arrival/return wording without claiming morphological parity.
Polite server-facing requests contrast with informal friend-directed questions. Qualified Japanese register review remains open.
The source says Matías will save oat milk when delivery arrives and the group will return in the afternoon; no actual delivery or return is shown.
